say:0:1821611001:1.text: After speaking with the patients, you sense the same problem in each of them—the magic inside their bodies has fallen badly out of balance.
say:0:1821611001:1.source_cn: 经过短暂的接触，你察觉到这些生病的偷渡者体内都有魔力紊...
say:0:1821611001:1.male: After speaking with the patients, you sense the same problem in each of them—the magic inside their bodies has fallen badly out of balance.
say:0:1821611001:1.female: After speaking with the patients, you sense the same problem in each of them—the magic inside their bodies has fallen badly out of balance.

say:1:1821611002:1.text: However, their disguises were created with gravecalling magic, which altered how their own magic behaves. For now, you have no idea how to treat them.
say:1:1821611002:1.source_cn: 然而施加在他们身上的伪装魔法属于亡灵法术的范畴，这让他...
say:1:1821611002:1.male: However, their disguises were created with gravecalling magic, which altered how their own magic behaves. For now, you have no idea how to treat them.
say:1:1821611002:1.female: However, their disguises were created with gravecalling magic, which altered how their own magic behaves. For now, you have no idea how to treat them.

say:4:1821611004:0.text: I... hah... I brought... the doctor!
say:4:1821611004:0.source_cn: 我……呼、呼……我把医生……带过来了！

say:5:1821611005:0.text: Deadreef Shipping must've scored big this time, bringing in so many sick stowaways. I bet the bonus was more than generous.
say:5:1821611005:0.source_cn: 居然有这么多生病的偷渡者，看来这次你们暗礁航运干了一票...

say:6:1821611006:1.text: Are you here to treat patients or make jokes?!
say:6:1821611006:1.source_cn: 喂！你到底是来救人的还是来闲聊的？！

say:7:1821611007:1.text: Please, argue later. Help them first!
say:7:1821611007:1.source_cn: 是啊……先别说这些了，快想办法救人吧！

say:8:1821611008:1.text: If anything happens to even one of them, there goes my bonus!
say:8:1821611008:1.source_cn: 但凡有一个人出事，我的奖金就全打水漂了！

say:9:1821611009:0.text: Fine. Everyone calm down. I'll examine them one at a time.
say:9:1821611009:0.source_cn: 哼，知道了。一个个看，别急。

narration:11:1821611011:1.text: Only after a long while does she stroll back over to you.
narration:11:1821611011:1.male: Only after a long while does she stroll back over to you.
narration:11:1821611011:1.female: Only after a long while does she stroll back over to you.

say:12:1821611012:0.text: I'm done. I know what's causing it.
say:12:1821611012:0.source_cn: 检查完了，病因也找到了。

choice_prompt:13:1821611012.text: I'm done. I know what's causing it.
choice_prompt:13:1821611012.source_cn: 检查完了，病因也找到了。

say:14:1821611013:1.text: The symptoms are all over the place—exhaustion, despair, delusions... It's quite a mess.
say:14:1821611013:1.source_cn: 每个人的病症不同，精力不足、悲观主义、认知失调等等，情...
say:14:1821611013:1.male: The symptoms are all over the place—exhaustion, despair, delusions... It's quite a mess.
say:14:1821611013:1.female: The symptoms are all over the place—exhaustion, despair, delusions... It's quite a mess.

say:15:1821611014:1.text: But they all have the same cause: no sunlight.
say:15:1821611014:1.source_cn: 不过，病因都一样：缺乏光照。
say:15:1821611014:1.male: But they all have the same cause: no sunlight.
say:15:1821611014:1.female: But they all have the same cause: no sunlight.

say:17:1821611016:1.text: You're saying they're sick because they haven't seen the sun?
say:17:1821611016:1.source_cn: 你是说他们生病是因为晒不到太阳？

say:18:1821611017:1.text: Exactly. Sunlight isn't only good for plants, you know.
say:18:1821611017:1.source_cn: 没错。你该不会天真地以为，只有植物才需要光照吧？

say:19:1821611018:1.text: The sunless city of Novaris was never a place for the living. A short visit is fine, but stay too long and your spirit will wither away, like a sunflower deprived of sunlight.
say:19:1821611018:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯这种没有太阳的地方不适合生者生活，偶尔来度个假没...

say:20:1821611019:1.text: Many of my living coworkers develop the same symptoms after staying here too long. It's quite common.
say:20:1821611019:1.source_cn: 我的许多生者同事，他们在诺珐斯待久了也会这样，很正常。

say:21:1821611020:1.text: What?! Visiting Novaris can make us sick? Why wasn't that in Deadreef Shipping's contract?!
say:21:1821611020:1.source_cn: 什么……来诺珐斯竟然有这么大的风险！为什么暗礁航运的合...

say:22:1821611021:1.text: The Syndicate writes the contracts. I don't get any say in what goes into them.
say:22:1821611021:1.source_cn: 合同是商会拟定的，我哪有权利决定它怎么写？

say:23:1821611022:1.text: Besides, we've never had a return voyage delayed before. We didn't know anyone would be stranded long enough for this to happen.
say:23:1821611022:1.source_cn: 而且我也没经历过返程延期的情况，更别提偷渡者生病的事了...

say:24:1821611023:1.text: And let's be honest—if we'd warned you, you might never have paid us in the first place.
say:24:1821611023:1.source_cn: 再说了，要是提前告诉你们，我不就挣不到钱了吗？

say:28:1821611029:1.text: Novaris has no sun, and the port is still closed. We have no way to return to the Lightbearer Empire!
say:28:1821611029:1.source_cn: 可是诺珐斯没有太阳，港口也不许船只出海，我们根本没办法...

say:29:1821611030:1.text: That's a transport problem. I'm a doctor.
say:29:1821611030:1.source_cn: 那就不是我该担心的事了。

say:30:1821611031:1.text: ... So after all that, you still can't help us!
say:30:1821611031:1.source_cn: ……所以说来说去，你们还是没法解决！

say:31:1821611032:1.text: I found the cause. At least now you know what you're dealing with.
say:31:1821611032:1.source_cn: 是，但至少我能找到病因，让你们安心一点。

say:32:1821611033:1.text: It isn't fatal. Once you're back in the Lightbearer Empire, the symptoms will clear on their own. You'll just have to be patient.
say:32:1821611033:1.source_cn: 又不是什么绝症。等你们回到耀光，自然而然就痊愈了，耐心点吧。

say:33:1821611034:1.text: Sylvie speaks as though the matter is settled. To a Graveborn doctor, it may seem minor, but you can't share her lack of concern for the stranded stowaways.
say:33:1821611034:1.source_cn: 茜尔万的话说得轻飘飘。在她这样的亡灵看来，这的确不是什...
say:33:1821611034:1.male: Sylvie speaks as though the matter is settled. To a Graveborn doctor, it may seem minor, but you can't share her lack of concern for the stranded stowaways.
say:33:1821611034:1.female: Sylvie speaks as though the matter is settled. To a Graveborn doctor, it may seem minor, but you can't share her lack of concern for the stranded stowaways.

say:34:1821611035:1.text: For now, the only option is to ask <style="highlight">Tephesia</style> to reopen the port.
say:34:1821611035:1.source_cn: 看来眼下唯一的办法，就是去找<style=highli...

choice:26:0:1.text: Forget the contract. How do we treat them?
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 怎么做才能治好这些偷渡者？
choice:26:0:1.male: Forget the contract. How do we treat them?
choice:26:0:1.female: Forget the contract. How do we treat them?

say:36:1821611026:1.text: The Syndicate has one, but it's for internal use only. We don't sell it.
say:36:1821611026:1.source_cn: 黑金内部药品，不对外售卖。
say:36:1821611026:1.male: The Syndicate has one, but it's for internal use only. We don't sell it.
say:36:1821611026:1.female: The Syndicate has one, but it's for internal use only. We don't sell it.

choice_prompt:37:1821611026.text: The Syndicate has one, but it's for internal use only. We don't sell it.
choice_prompt:37:1821611026.source_cn: 黑金内部药品，不对外售卖。
choice_prompt:37:1821611026.male: The Syndicate has one, but it's for internal use only. We don't sell it.
choice_prompt:37:1821611026.female: The Syndicate has one, but it's for internal use only. We don't sell it.

say:38:1821611027:0.text: You can't. The building is gone. Whatever medicine was inside is probably dust by now.
say:38:1821611027:0.source_cn: 那也没办法。大楼毁了，那些药大概都被碾成粉末了。
say:38:1821611027:0.male: You can't. The building is gone. Whatever medicine was inside is probably dust by now.
say:38:1821611027:0.female: You can't. The building is gone. Whatever medicine was inside is probably dust by now.

say:39:1821611028:0.text: Fortunately, you don't need it. Sunlight works just as well.
say:39:1821611028:0.source_cn: 不过还有另一个更简单的办法——晒太阳。
say:39:1821611028:0.male: Fortunately, you don't need it. Sunlight works just as well.
say:39:1821611028:0.female: Fortunately, you don't need it. Sunlight works just as well.

choice:37:1:2.text: If you won't sell it, I'll take it.
choice:37:1:2.source_cn: 不卖的话，我只能硬抢了
choice:37:1:2.male: If you won't sell it, I'll take it.
choice:37:1:2.female: If you won't sell it, I'll take it.

choice:26:1:2.text: Is there any medicine that can ease the symptoms until then?
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 有没有药能缓解他们的症状？
choice:26:1:2.male: Is there any medicine that can ease the symptoms until then?
choice:26:1:2.female: Is there any medicine that can ease the symptoms until then?
